evidence: During Pd ALD on Al2O3 surfaces using Pd/hfac2 and formalin, the Al2O3 surface becomes rapidly poisoned by Al/hfac/ surface species. 9 Recent FTIR studies showed that Pd/hfac2 adsorption on Al2O3 yielded both Pd/hfac/ and Al/hfac/ surface species. 9 After the subsequent formalin exposure, only Pd/hfac/ species were removed from the surface. 9
